{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Has the P2P label and changes `net_processing.cpp` to optimize how the node serves `MSG_BLOCK` data requests to peers.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.45,
      "reason_tag": "speedup",
      "rationale": "Optimizes serving disk-backed `MSG_BLOCK` requests by stripping witnesses directly from raw bytes, achieving an 8.9x-9.3x speedup in block preparation time and reducing heap allocations. While valuable and prerequisite for proposed witnessless IBD (#36476), `MSG_BLOCK` is primarily requested by legacy peers, making this deferrable relative to critical network relay work."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches `src/bench/readwriteblock.cpp` and `src/test/fuzz/block.cpp` only to benchmark and fuzz the new block stripping logic, not to modify test harness machinery.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "The PR adds tests specifically covering the P2P block-stripping routine rather than changing general test framework infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches `src/node/blockstorage.cpp` and `src/primitives/transaction.h` strictly to support non-witness serialization reading for P2P serving without altering validation logic or invariants.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "speedup",
      "rationale": "The change does not alter consensus rules, block validation, chainstate, or block connection performance; it only modifies reading block bytes from storage to construct P2P messages."
    }
  ],
